ORDINANCE IX OF 1977
BALUCHISTAN LAND REVENUE (ABOLITION) ORDINANCE, 1977
An Ordinance to abolish land
revenue in the Province of Baluchistan
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 7th November 1977]
No. Legis. 1-47/Law/71. Vol.
III.-The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 7th
November 1977, is hereby published for general information :--
1. Sort title, extent and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be
called the Baluchistan Land Revenue (Abolition) Ordinance, 1977.
(2) It shall extend to the whole
of the Province of Baluchistan except Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on anti from 5th Day of January
1977.

Abolition of Land Revenue

ORDINANCE IX OF 1977
ORDINANCE IX OF 1977
BALUCHISTAN LAND REVENUE (ABOLITION) ORDINANCE, 1977
An Ordinance to abolish land
revenue in the Province of Baluchistan
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 7th November 1977]
No. Legis. 1-47/Law/71. Vol.
III.-The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 7th
November 1977, is hereby published for general information :--
2. Abolition of Land Revenue.--Notwithstanding anything to the
contrary contained in the Baluchistan Land Revenue Act, 1967, or any other law
for the time being in force, no land revenue, as defined in the Baluchistan
Land Revenue Act, 1967, becoming due as from Rabi 1976-77 shall be assessed,
levied or charged.

Saving

ORDINANCE IX OF 1977
ORDINANCE IX OF 1977
BALUCHISTAN LAND REVENUE (ABOLITION) ORDINANCE, 1977
An Ordinance to abolish land
revenue in the Province of Baluchistan
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 7th November 1977]
No. Legis. 1-47/Law/71. Vol.
III.-The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 7th
November 1977, is hereby published for general information :--
3. Saving.--Nothing contained in section 2 of this Ordinance shall
be construed to affect the liability of any person to pay the land revenue
which bath become due before Rabi 1976-77, or the assessment, levy, charge and
collection of the land revenue or any dues recoverable as land revenue for the period
before Rabi 1976-77 which shall continue to be done under the provisions of the
Baluchistan Land Revenue Act, 1976.
